description:
Lead Digital Media Planner / Buyer - Remote, Latin America

Join to apply for the Lead Digital Media Planner / Buyer - Remote, Latin America role at Bluelight.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive.

With a presence across the United States and Central / South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies. Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible.

We're seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency's thriving team philosophy.

Media Planning & Strategy

Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client goals and target audiences.

Conduct in‑depth research and analysis to identify optimal media channels and strategies.

Determine budget allocation across channels based on performance and objectives.

Stay abreast of emerging digital media trends, technologies, and AI integrations.

Advise the New Business teams and Account teams on recommended budgets and media strategies during the pitch process.

Campaign Execution & Management

Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns across various platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms, programmatic display).

Manage relationships with external vendors responsible for day‑to‑day campaign management.

Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Analyze campaign performance data to identify areas for optimization and improvement.

Generate regular reports on campaign performance and insights.

Budget Management

Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.

Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.

Identify opportunities for cost‑saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

4+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services / recruiting to software development firms.

Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).

Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.

Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third‑party trackers, etc.).

Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Self‑motivated, detail‑oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.

Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.

Generous paid‑time‑off policy.

Flexible working hours.

Work remotely.

Continuing education, training, conferences.

Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You'll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you're eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior UX / UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Ollyis a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.

We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.

A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.

The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX / UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.

Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.

You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture : Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion : Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design : Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking : Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error‑proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement : Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.

What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of professional UX / UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile / app design).

A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate

  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.

Expert-level proficiency in Figma

  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg / Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work / life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule.
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

Why Join Us?

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.

How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.

Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web / theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, quesempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana , tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.

Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.

Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Europe)

Our network doesn’t just move fast, it hops. We handle millions of requests every second across 120+ PoPs on six continents, powering not just a lightning-fast CDN, but also a global Edge Computing platform, Streaming services, and petabyte-scale Storage.

As our footprint expands, so does the challenge, and the fun. That’s where you come in.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll design and shape the global infrastructure that makes bunny.net hop.   • Solve complex challenges in large-scale distributed systems and networking stacks
  • Automate the boring stuff, reducing toil and streamlining server setup worldwide
  • Level up our monitoring game with meaningful metrics, alerts, and dashboards that keep us ahead of issues

  • Own the systems you build, participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation to keep everything performing at its best

  • A growth mindset with eagerness to learn, adapt, and shape the future of a fast-moving technical stack, especially with a focus on reliability

  • Hands‑on experience with monitoring systems like metrics, alerts, logs, and runbooks (we run our own Prometheus exporters, craft our own Grafana dashboards, and write the alerts we respond to)

  • Experience running SQL / NoSQL databases like MariaDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, or Cassandra
  • Ability to write tools and scripts in Bash, Python, or Go

Where should you be located?

Fully remote across Europe — work from where you hop best.

  • Experience with CDNs, edge computing, streaming platforms, or object storage projects
  • A passion for observability, with a good understanding of how systems behave as a whole, not just checking if they’re “healthy”
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks and using them to introduce meaningful, lasting improvements
  • Hands‑on involvement in network design, implementation, and monitoring (BGP, Spine‑Leaf, Anycast are all in your vocabulary)
  • Deep experience tuning and scaling databases such as MariaDB or Cassandra in high‑traffic environments.
  • Experience in Disaster Recovery or Business Continuity Planning (and ready to help shape bunny.net’s DR strategy)
  • Skills in hardware performance tuning, from NIC queues to flamegraphs and performance dashboards

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

Annual fluffle‑building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high‑fives turn into real ones.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities : text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities :

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies :

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements :

  • Bachelor's degree / diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI / ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm / high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer :

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Técnico de Enfermagem - Centro Cirúrgico

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Sua rotina como técnico de enfermagem será:

  • Auxiliar no preparo da sala cirúrgica/obstétrico, segundo cada caso específico, no provimento dos materiais necessários à realização de cada ato cirúrgico, conforme programação informada;
  • Receber o paciente, conferir pulseira de identificação conforme protocolo de cirurgia e parto seguro e certificar-se de que está devidamente preparado, encaminhá-lo para a sala e auxiliar no transporte da maca para a mesa cirúrgica/obstétrica e vice-versa;
  • Auxiliar na realização dos procedimentos pré-cirúrgico /obstétrico e anestésicos, posicionando o paciente e fornecendo os materiais necessários no decorrer de sua realização;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente durante a sua permanência no Centro, tendo em vista o seu bem-estar físico e psíquico, e auxiliar no seu encaminhamento ao setor de destino, após liberação do médico;
  • Executar as solicitações médicas e da Enfermeira, segundo orientações específicas e definidas;
  • Realizar controle de materiais esterilizados disponíveis para a realização de procedimentos, verificando sempre a data de validade, conforme rotina específica do setor;
  • Conferir o instrumental utilizado após cada ato cirúrgico/obstétrico e acondicioná-lo para fins de remessa para lavagem e esterilização;
  • Preencher as notas de sala segundo procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista a correta apropriação dos materiais utilizados e a confiabilidade na emissão da conta hospitalar correspondente;
  • Registrar os procedimentos realizados no prontuário, conforme procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista disponibilizar as informações necessárias para a continuidade do trabalho.
  • Manusear sistema PEP com prontuário eletrônico.
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem concluído;
  • Registro Coren BA ativo e regularizado;
  • Experiência na área de enfermagem com atuação em centro cirúrgico;
  • Disponibilidade para plantões.

Os benefícios que você terá com a FJS:

  • Plano de saúde
  • Programa de saúde do colaborador
  • Step 2: Entrevista com o RH 2 Entrevista com o RH

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

Engenheiro de Dados Sênior | Temporária A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão: Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Ser a pessoa responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações acessíveis e confiáveis, conectando a área técnica às necessidades de negócio e garantindo que as soluções construídas sustentem a tomada de decisão estratégica da empresa.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Criar e evoluir processos de arquitetura de dados;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas e comunicá-las ao time de dados;
  • Elaborar desenhos de solução e propor melhorias;
  • Gerar especificações técnicas e documentações das soluções;
  • Fomentar a reutilização de componentes e o repasse de conhecimento entre squads;
  • Elaborar PoCs (Provas de Conceito) para validação de soluções;
  • Otimizar processos de ETL;
  • Disseminar melhores práticas de uso e governança de dados;
  • Contribuir em projetos de migração e integração de dados;
  • Participar de discussões baseadas em dados, apoiando decisões estratégicas.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Data Lake Storage);
  • Vivência em criação de desenhos de solução e modelagem de dados (relacionais e não relacionais);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados, aplicando políticas e processos eficazes;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação técnica e arquitetural;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho colaborativo com diferentes áreas;
  • Interesse contínuo em aprender e se atualizar em novas tecnologias;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integrações de dados complexas;
  • Experiência com Big Data, utilizando ferramentas como Jupyter Notebook, Hadoop, R, Python e MapReduce.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Atuar na definição e implementação de arquiteturas de dados, tanto em Cloud quanto On-Premises;
  • Construir e manter estruturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Liderar tecnicamente times ou iniciativas de engenharia de dados;
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança e segurança da informação;
  • Possuir certificações Microsoft relevantes para a área (como Azure Data Engineer ou Azure Solutions Architect).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser;
  • Benefícios de alimentação e home office;
  • Day-off no aniversário;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers;
  • Saúde e bem-estar;
  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal;
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional);
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento;
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer;
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga.

O que nos diferencia? Carreira e desenvolvimento: Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills, oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo.

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

Inscrição Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui. Bate-papo com People Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura. Entrevista técnica com liderança Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências. Feedback final Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Planejamento e Orçamento

Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência operacional e financeira, propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis.

Realizar análises ad-hoc (sob demanda) para suportar a tomada de decisão da gestão local e corporativa, incluindo precificação, análise de contratos e avaliação de riscos financeiros.

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.

Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.

Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

  • Grande capacidade de autogestão.
  • Estudos em Recursos Humanos, psicologia ou carreiras relacionadas.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

  • Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a diluição e envase de produtos saneantes conforme instruções técnicas e tabelas padrão;
  • Higienizar e preparar bombonas, almotolias e frascos pra uso;
  • Identificar e rotular corretamente todos os produtos diluídos, com informações completas e legíveis;
  • Preencher e assinar, junto ao farmacêutico, a ficha técnica de manipulação;
  • Realizar armazenamento dos produtos recebidos e diluídos conforme as normas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as medições da temperatura do ambiente de armazenamento e sala de manipulação;
  • Identificar e remover produtos com suspeita de contaminação, violação ou vencimento;
  • Realizar a entrega dos produtos saneantes nos setores hospitalares, com controle de protocolo de entrega e assinatura dos responsáveis;
  • Dispensar os produtos mediante solicitação via sistema, seguindo o fluxo interno de registro e conferência;
  • Recolher, separar e higienizar os materiais utilizados na manipulação;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Utilizar corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) durante todas as atividades;
  • Acionar os dispositivos de segurança (lava-olhos e chuveiro de emergência) em caso de acidente com produtos químicos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.

Additional information

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

  • Objetividade e postura estratégica.
  • Raciocínio lógico, crítico e analítico.
  • Habilidade para decidir com rapidez sem perder qualidade na entrega.
  • Forte habilidade de negociação e relacionamento institucional.
  • Autonomia para análise de planejamento estratégico e decisões administrativas.

description:
Job description

Somos um grupo multimarcas que atua na comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, acessórios, consórcios, frota, seguros e pós-vendas realizado na nossa rede de concessionárias além do serviço de locação (mobilidade).

Executivo de Vendas para promover o encantamento ao cliente que entrar no showroom da Concessionária, estando sempre atualizado sobre todos os benefícios do mix de produtos oferecidos, conhecer e aplicar técnicas eficazes de venda e negociação, identificando a necessidade de cada cliente, garantindo o fechamento do negócio e a total satisfação, com foco nos objetivos propostos para área comercial.

Se você é uma pessoa ágil, que encanta o cliente e preza pela excelência em resultados, venha fazer parte do nossotime !

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente que adentrar no showroom, aplicando a metodologia do padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir os objetivos quantitativos e qualitativos, assim como as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.
  • Demonstrar, durante o atendimento ao cliente, as vantagens da marca BMW, através de comparativos com outras marcas, com o objetivo de promover o encantamento do cliente e a realização da venda.
  • Informar aos clientes as políticas comerciais do Grupo, garantindo o bom atendimento e preservação da credibilidade do Grupo.
  • Realizar financiamento, através de negociação com o cliente, com o objetivo de encontrar o melhor cálculo de financiamento para o produto, atendendo as expectativas do cliente, promovendo a satisfação do mesmo e o fechamento da negociação.
  • Realizar vendas mensais, equilibrando volume, ISC (Índice de Satisfação do Cliente), lucratividade, acessórios, F&I e serviços, buscando atingir os objetivos da empresa e individuais.

  • Acompanhar e controlar, diariamente, a sua agenda, através do sistema corporativo de gestão de relacionamento com cliente (SYONET/BIC), buscando através da prospecção atrair e gerar oportunidades de negócio, inerentes aos objetivos comerciais do Grupo.

  • Noções informática;
  • Técnicas de vendas e negociação;

  • Atendimento ao cliente;

O #GrupoNewChase é o seu lugar!

title: SA Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
Lead the Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) for South America, ensuring standardized, efficient and compliant processes across Direct and Indirect Purchasing, Business Office and Purchasing Systems. The role governs policies, processes and systems, secures audit and regulatory compliance, and provides performance visibility to management. A critical mandate is to lead, for South America, the business side of the I‑ERP program, driving the successful implementation and adoption of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing, enabling data‑driven decisions and sustainable operational excellence.

Qualifications

Profile / Requirements

Education

  • University degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems or related field.
  • Post‑graduate degree or MBA is a plus.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in Supply Chain and/or Purchasing, preferably in a multinational and multi‑plant environment.
  • Proven track record in process governance, standardization and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross‑functional projects; prior ERP implementation experience (ideally SAP S/4HANA and/or Ariba) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with audits, compliance programs and policy/procedure management.

Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Purchasing and Supply Chain processes (Direct and Indirect).
  • Good understanding of ERP systems; hands‑on familiarity with SAP and e‑Procurement solutions (e.g., Ariba) is highly valued.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban or SAFe) in project delivery, including backlog management, sprint or increment planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Competence in process mapping and documentation tools; experience with KPI design and performance dashboards (e.g., Excel, Power BI or similar).
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

Languages

  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Fluency in English required for regional and global interaction.

Competencies and Behaviors

Aligned with Ford Behaviors – Focus, Excellence and Collaboration :

  • Focus
    • Sets clear priorities and focuses the organization on the highest‑value Supply Chain and I‑ERP outcomes for South America.
    • Translates strategy into an executable roadmap, ensuring resources and attention are directed to what matters most for customers and the business.
  • Excellence
    • Drives disciplined execution, process rigor and high standards in policies, audits, data quality and systems usage.
    • Uses data and structured problem‑solving to deliver continuous improvement in cost, quality, timing and compliance.
    • Champions best practices and lessons learned from audits and projects, embedding them into standard work.
  • Collaboration
    • Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across countries, plants and functions (Supply Chain, Purchasing, Finance, IT, global CoEs).
    • Facilitates cross‑functional alignment, resolves conflicts constructively and creates a “one team” mindset for I‑ERP and operational initiatives.
    • Communicates clearly and transparently, ensuring stakeholders are informed, engaged and heard.

Additional Behavioral Capabilities

  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through transformation, particularly digital and ERP changes, with strong emphasis on communication, training and user adoption.
  • Results Orientation: Delivers on commitments, manages priorities and deadlines, and ensures projects achieve expected outcomes in terms of cost, quality and timing.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Focus: Balances global standards with local needs; actively listens to internal customers and provides pragmatic, value‑adding solutions.
  • Integrity and Compliance Mindset: Acts as a role model for ethical behavior, policy adherence and audit readiness.

Key Interfaces

  • Regional Purchasing, Supply Chain and Logistics teams
  • Plant and Country management in South America
  • Finance, Controlling and Compliance functions
  • Global Supply Chain and Purchasing Centers of Excellence
  • Global I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) program team and IT organization
  • External auditors, consultants and solution providers (as needed)

#LI-FordArgentina

#LI-FD1

Responsibilities

Main Activities / Key Responsibilities

  • Process Governance and Standardization
    • Lead the definition, mapping, documentation and continuous improvement of end‑to‑end Direct and Indirect Purchasing processes across South America.
    • Ensure alignment with global standards, internal controls, legal and compliance requirements, harmonizing practices across countries and plants.
    • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for Supply Chain and Purchasing processes and drive corrective/improvement actions.
  • Policy, Procedure and Audit Management
    • Own and maintain regional Supply Chain and Purchasing policies, procedures, work instructions and standards, ensuring regular review and updates.
    • Plan, coordinate and support internal and external audits related to Purchasing (e.g., ISO9001, MCRP, SA DRIM, AFR campaigns, OIC Direct & Indirect Purchasing).
    • Lead the response to audit findings, define corrective actions, track implementation and embed lessons learned into processes and systems.
  • Business Office Leadership
    • Manage Business Office routines for South America Supply Chain, including governance calendars, meeting preparation and action follow‑up.
    • Consolidate and analyze performance data, preparing management reports, dashboards and executive presentations that provide clear visibility of results, risks and opportunities.
    • Support regional and global leadership in strategic planning, target setting and tracking of major initiatives.
  • Purchasing Systems Ownership
    • Act as regional business owner for Purchasing and Supply Chain systems and tools, in coordination with global process owners and IT.
    • Ensure robust system configuration, data quality, master data governance and proper access management.
    • Provide guidance and support to users, including issue resolution, enhancement requests and coordination of training needs.
  • I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) Leadership – South America
    • Lead, from the business side, the South America implementation of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing (I‑ERP).
    • Coordinate the collection and validation of business requirements, process design and solution blueprinting, ensuring fit‑for‑purpose and standardized processes.
    • Oversee integration testing, user acceptance testing, data migration preparation and validation, cut‑over planning and post‑go‑live stabilization.
    • Develop and execute change‑management, communication and training plans to drive strong user adoption and realize expected benefits.
    • Act as key interface between regional business teams and global program/IT, ensuring timely issue resolution and decision‑making.
  • Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement
    • Coordinate cross‑functional and cross‑country teams (Purchasing, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Plants and Corporate functions) to ensure consistent deployment of processes and systems.
    • Identify optimization opportunities in cost, quality, lead time, compliance and data reliability; prioritize and lead or sponsor related improvement projects.
    • Promote a culture of process discipline, digitalization and continuous improvement across the South America Supply Chain organization.

title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – AI & Engineering Strategy
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a visionary Deputy CTO with deep experience transforming engineering processes through the strategic use of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The ideal candidate is a hands‑on leader who has successfully guided development teams toward higher velocity, quality, and operational excellence by introducing and optimizing AI‑powered practices.

In this role, you will help us refine, elevate, and scale our existing engineering processes, strengthening the connection between architectural governance, team growth, and customer‑facing technical leadership.

AI-Driven Development Transformation

  • Accelerate SDLC: Lead the adoption of Generative AI tools and coding assistants to reduce cycle times and eliminate repetitive engineering tasks drastically.
  • Measure Impact: Define and track KPIs related to AI adoption (e.g., velocity increase, code quality metrics, reduction in technical debt) to prove ROI.
  • AI Governance & Ethics: Establish a secure framework for using AI tools within the company, ensuring strict adherence to data privacy, IP protection, and security compliance standards.

Technical Architecture & Innovation

  • Architectural Oversight: Design and oversee the roadmap for complex, scalable platforms, ensuring they are built for resilience and future growth.
  • Tech Stack Modernization: Continuously evaluate and optimize our infrastructure and cloud strategy to support high-performance AI integration.
  • Mentorship: Provide high-level technical guidance to Principal Engineers and Architects, resolving complex blockers and fostering technical excellence.

Organizational Leadership & Scaling

  • Team Building: Build and structure high‑performing engineering teams from the ground up, optimizing for agility and cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Process Optimization: Implement "AI-native" workflows that redefine how we hire, onboard, and manage engineering talent for maximum output.
  • Culture of Innovation: Foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, but accountability and delivery are paramount.

Commercial & Client Strategy

  • Serve as the primary technical voice in high‑stakes client meetings, simplifying complex architectural concepts into compelling business value propositions.
  • Business Growth: Partner with Sales and Product teams to articulate the competitive advantage of our AI‑enabled development processes to prospective clients and investors.
  • Client Solution Viability & Compliance: Ensure the flexibility and compliance of AI adoption strategies (governance, tools, data privacy) to meet the diverse security and regulatory requirements of our clients.

Must Have

  • Senior Leadership Experience: 5+ years in a senior technology role (VP of Engineering, CTO, or Deputy CTO) with a focus on software delivery.
  • AI Implementation Track Record: Demonstrable experience leading the transformation of engineering teams through Generative AI (e.g., LLMs for code generation, automated testing suites, and documentation).
  • Proven ROI Analysis: Expertise in quantifying the efficiency gains derived from technical initiatives and reporting these to executive stakeholders.
  • Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of security risks and governance associated with using third‑party AI tools in an enterprise environment.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy for non‑technical audiences.
  • Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Hands‑on experience working with several modern technologies such as .NET, Python, React/React Native, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript , among others. This includes the ability to guide teams across diverse frameworks, evaluate technological trade‑offs, and define best practices across frontend, backend, and full‑stack development.
  • Infrastructure Background: Deep experience in large‑scale system architecture and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Language Skills: Full fluency in English (required). Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is considered a strong plus.

What We Offer

- Strategic Impact: Redefine how software is built.

- Innovation Hub: A collaborative environment where your vision directly shapes our competitive edge in the market.

- Comprehensive Package: Competitive salary, stock options, and premium benefits.

description:

O Gerente de Pós-Vendas é o responsável por garantir a satisfação dos clientes após a venda, assegurando a excelência nos serviços prestados pela oficina, funilaria, peças e atendimento.

1. Gestão Operacional da Oficina

  • Coordenar o fluxo de serviços da oficina mecânica, funilaria e pintura.
  • Garantir produtividade, qualidade técnica e cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como horas trabalhadas, retrabalho, ocupação da oficina e eficiência dos técnicos.
  • Supervisionar diagnósticos, orçamentos e aprovações de serviços.

2. Gestão da Equipe

  • Liderar consultores técnicos, técnicos mecânicos, estoquistas e demais colaboradores do pós-vendas.
  • Realizar reuniões, feedbacks, avaliações de desempenho e treinamentos.
  • Organizar escalas, jornadas e apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional da equipe.

3. Atendimento e Satisfação do Cliente

  • Garantir atendimento ágil, cordial e transparente durante toda a jornada do cliente.
  • Tratar reclamações, conduzir negociações e buscar soluções para aumentar a satisfação.
  • Acompanhar índices como NPS, CSI e retenção de clientes.
  • Implementar ações para melhorar a experiência e fidelização.

4. Gestão de Peças e Estoque

  • Monitorar a disponibilidade, giro e acuracidade do estoque de peças.
  • Controlar compras, devoluções, perdas e negociações com fornecedores.
  • Assegurar que a área de peças atenda à demanda da oficina e ao balcão externo.

5. Resultados Financeiros

  • Acompanhar metas de faturamento, lucratividade e margem de contribuição da área.
  • Controlar custos operacionais, descontos e garantias.
  • Elaborar planos para aumentar a performance comercial do pós-vendas.

6. Processos, Qualidade e Garantia

  • Assegurar conformidade com normas da montadora e políticas internas.
  • Realizar auditorias internas e preparar a equipe para auditorias externas.
  • Gerenciar processos de garantia, recall e campanhas técnicas.

7. Relacionamento com a Montadora

  • Participar de reuniões, treinamentos e atualizações técnicas oferecidas pela marca.
  • Implementar programas e projetos exigidos pela montadora.
  • Acompanhar indicadores específicos determinados pelo fabricante.

8. Estratégia e Desenvolvimento do Negócio

  • Desenvolver ações para captar novos clientes e aumentar retorno à oficina.
  • Criar campanhas comerciais e pós-vendas em conjunto com marketing e vendas.
  • Mapear oportunidades, corrigir falhas e melhorar continuamente os processos.

description:
Senior Cloud Frontline Support Specialist

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Acronis is revolutionizing cyber protection—providing natively integrated, all-in-one solutions that monitor, control, and protect the data that businesses and lives depend on. We are looking for a Cloud Support Specialist to join our mission to create a #CyberFit future and protect all data, applications and systems across any environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide technical support, configuration and troubleshooting of software-related inquiries via email, phone and chat for customers and MSPs
  • Perform technical analysis of customer problems and define plan for resolving it
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners
  • Interact daily with other engineers to provide technical action plans or take ownership of cases that require escalation
  • Work closely with the Expert team to answer Customers’ technical questions (act as liaison between the customer and internal Acronis resources)
  • Meet and exceed KPIs set for your role (customer satisfaction, productivity, interaction quality and others)
  • Ensure that all relevant communication, documents, and files related to the case are accurately recorded in the support system

What You Bring (experience & qualification)

  • Fluent English and Spanish language (both verbal and written, Upper Intermediate as a minimum)
  • 1 or more years of work experience in a similar role (preferably in Hosting tech support or Managed Service Provider business)
  • Knowledge of Windows Server administration basics (know how to gather and analyze various Windows logs and dumps)
  • Ability to convey technical information effectively
  • Ability to analyze technical issues
  • Exceptional customer service approach and excellent analytical skills

Would Be Considered a Plus If You Have

  • Experience and knowledge of Linux/UNIX basics, CLI
  • Awareness of the modern Virtualization technologies (experience deploying and managing virtual machines on VMware ESXi / Microsoft Hyper‑V clusters)
  • Experience with Business applications (MS Exchange, MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle DB, Citrix XenApp, NTP servers)
  • Please submit your resume and application in English

Who We Are

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for managed service providers (MSPs), small and medium businesses (SMBs), enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect and belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. We seek individuals who excel in dynamic, global environments and have a never give up attitude, contributing to our collective growth and impact.

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Operations Manager
description:
This position will be based in the Recife region. Amazon is looking for an Operations Manager to be based in our new Fulfillment Center in Recife. The Operations Manager has complete responsibility for all processes within a warehouse on a specified shift or across multiple shifts. Reporting to the Sr. Ops Manager, you will be directly responsible for a team of Area /Team Managers and their direct reports. You will work to continuously improve the functionality and level of service that we provide our customers, resulting in exceeded productivity goals and delivery against our customer promises.

As the Operations Manager you will:

  • Lead and supervise a team of Area Managers and hourly associates in outbound and/or inbound operations for the night shift.
  • Responsible for the overall safety, quality, performance and customer experience of the shift.
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
  • Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals.
  • Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance; reward and discipline employees; resolve problems; and address staffing needs.
  • Mentor, train and develop teammates for career progression and learning.
  • Ability to develop and share best practices across the shifts and network.
  • Proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive staffing plans, schedules, quality initiatives, performance levels, process change initiatives, and other Process Improvement/ Six Sigma initiatives to enable Operations and to attain the Business Plan.
  • Manage a team of many employees within a very fast-paced/ time-critical and demanding environment. This will include the setup and implementation of career development plans for all your Direct Reports, i.e. the Area Managers.
  • Manage a shift directly and a major process directly or indirectly – becoming a subject matter expert in your area.
  • Set / clarify requirements and expectations for Area Managers and Team Leaders.
  • Work closely with other support teams (HR, Financial Manager, Facilities Manager, Safety & Security Manager, IT Manager) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and procedures.
  • Implement change and/or develop new processes as required.
  • Participate from time to time in cross-functional Process and Business Improvement projects.
  • Candidates must be flexible to work weekends and/or overnight shifts regularly.
  • Mobility/ Relocation for one of the regions: Northeast of Brazil.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Administration, Economy, Data Processing, Computer Engineering, Mathematics or any correlated degrees.
  • Experience managing teams.
  • Employee and performance management experience.
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Operations or Logistics experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or Post Graduate Degree
  • Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing and process improvement
  • SQL and Advanced Excel

description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pelas demandas de pagamento, recebimentos, e execução das rotinas contábeis em conformidade com as exigências legais e normas internas, visando apuração dos elementos necessários à elaboração de balanços e balancetes patrimonial, ajudando a garantir a integridade financeira e o sucesso contínuo da organização.

DESCRIÇÃO DAS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Garantir a precisão e integridade das transações financeiras registradas nos livros contábeis da empresa, incluindo receitas, despesas, ativos e passivos.
  • Garantir que a empresa esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações fiscais e contábeis aplicáveis e em conformidade com os padrões contábeis locais e internacionais.
  • Apresentar relatórios financeiros periódicos, como balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados e fluxos de caixa.
  • Fornecer análises financeiras contribuindo na definição de diretrizes em alinhamento ao planejamento estratégico da empresa e na tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de finanças na preparação e revisão de orçamentos, previsões e planos financeiros para garantir que os recursos financeiros sejam alocados de forma eficaz e estratégica para apoiar os objetivos da empresa.
  • Analisar e identificar os riscos financeiros associados às operações da empresa e implementar controles internos eficazes para mitigar esses riscos, reduzir perdas e aumentar o lucro.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas fiscal, financeira, jurídica e recursos humanos, para garantir uma compreensão abrangente das operações da empresa e visando aumentar a performance da equipe.
  • Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a eficiência e eficácia dos processos contábeis da empresa, implementando melhores práticas e sistemas automatizados sempre que possível.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças nas normas contábeis e regulamentações fiscais, participando de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento profissional para aprimorar suas habilidades e conhecimentos.
  • Representar a empresa na análise das informações contábeis, fiscais e de departamento de pessoal.
  • Elaborar procedimentos e instruções de trabalho com base nos conhecimentos em Sistemas de Contabilidade e Financeiro, SPEDs (ECD/ECF), pesquisa IBGE.

FORMAÇÃO/HABILIDADES ESPECIAIS/EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Formação: Superior Completo - Ciências Contábeis
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação e/ou MBA em Contabilidade e/ou Controladoria e/ou Auditoria e/ou Finanças
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas de Contabilidade e Financeiro e em Declarações acessórias, SPEDs, PERDCOMP, fechamento fiscal e contábil e SUDENE

title: Sr. Process Manager, Outbound - Fulfillment Center ACES, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)
description:
Sr. Process Manager, Outbound - Fulfillment Center ACES, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Specialist for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Specialist, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.

Key job responsibilities

  • being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
  • leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
  • leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
  • owning and managing change on a granular level;
  • performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
  • work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.

A day in the life

You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:

  • FC Ops
  • Middle Mile and Last Mile teams
  • Learning
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Loss Prevention

You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.

About the team

The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience with program or project management.
  • Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams.
  • Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics.
  • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL.
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
  • Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus).
  • Advanced English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience.
  • Experience driving complex process improvements.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization.
  • Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
  • Black Belt certification.

title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist
description:
Job Title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist – McTernan lab

Reporting to: Charlie McTernan, Group Leader

Contract: full‑time, fixed term (15 months) on Crick terms and conditions of employment.

Closing date: 3rd December at 23:59.

About us

The Francis Crick Institute is Europe’s largest biomedical research institute under one roof. Our world‑class scientists and staff collaborate on vital research to help prevent, diagnose and treat illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, infectious diseases and neurodegenerative conditions.

About the role

The McTernan Group are a synthetic chemistry group working in supramolecular and biological chemistry, and nanotechnology. We look at how we can apply Supramolecular Chemistry in Biological settings.

Details of research projects currently being undertaken can be seen at: mcternanresearchgroup.com

The Project

This project is a translational and basic research project, looking to apply supramolecular chemistry to create mechanically interlocked peptides, with targeted applications in supramolecular drug delivery systems.

What you will be doing

  • Investigating research questions and developing specific research project(s) under guidance from Group Leader.
  • Providing specialist advice and guidance, sharing knowledge and expertise for the benefit of others.
  • Providing a significant contribution to the production of research papers for publication, presenting findings to group members and other internal and external audiences.
  • Develop ideas for generating research income, and present detailed research proposals.
  • Act as a source of information and advice to other members of the group on scientific protocols and experimental techniques.
  • Have a pro‑active approach to the management of health and safety protocols and play a leading role within the group in ensuring compliance with safety policy.
  • Acting as a leader within the group, helping to maintain a collaborative, kind, and supportive research environment; helping group members to achieve their potential.

About you

  • PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry and/or Chemical Biology and/or Supramolecular Chemistry and/or Solid‑Phase Peptide Synthesis or related field.
  • Expertise in organic synthesis at a high level.
  • Track record of writing papers as evidenced by impactful publications in refereed journals or submitted manuscripts.
  • Evidence of data presentation at scientific meetings.
  • Evidence of ability to supervise and educate junior co‑workers and take part in joint projects.
  • Be willing to lead the organisation and management of the laboratory, assuming a share of group responsibilities, showing excellent organisational and leadership skills.
  • A pro‑active approach to management of laboratory safety.

*Minimum requirements

About Working at the Crick

At the Francis Crick Institute, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving innovation and scientific discovery. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed, regardless of their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ethnicities, abilities, and experiences. We are a Disability Confident: committed employer and want to ensure that everyone can apply and be part of our recruitment processes and so we’ll make reasonable adjustments if you need them – just let us know when you apply. Descentralizamos a economia e demos autonomia para que os clientes pudessem ser protagonistas da própria vida financeira através de informações (antes restritas aos bancos) e conhecimento.

Faça parte da nossa equipe e da transformação que estamos causando no sistema financeiro!

description:
Descrição da vaga

O estágio na área da Controladoria está à sua espera! Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e apaixonada, pronta para transformar a mobilidade global, seu lugar é aqui. Na Conti, você terá a oportunidade de encarar desafios, trabalhar em equipe, se desenvolver e ver suas ideias se tornarem realidade.

Diversidade e inclusão são pilares fundamentais do nosso sucesso. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes perfis tornam nosso time ainda mais forte. Por isso, incentivamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), membros da comunidade LGBTI+ e pessoas negras. Sua inscrição será muito bem-vinda! #ContiComigo

Aqui na Conti, essas são as principais atividades dos estagiários área da Controladoria:

  • Participar dos processos de forecast e actual no fechamento mensal para as áreas de logística, manutenção, projetos, produção, entre outras.

  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios e apresentações financeiras utilizados nas reuniões de performance, consolidando resultados e indicadores para a gestão.

  • Apoiar análises de tendência de custos, atualizando informações nos sistemas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.

  • Manter e aprimorar dashboards financeiros e operacionais no Power BI e Excel, integrando dados dos sistemas utilizados na Continental.

  • Contribuir para a otimização de relatórios, automação de planilhas e integração de dados financeiros, buscando eficiência nas rotinas da área.

  • Realizar follow-up com líderes de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e responsáveis por centros de custo sobre o planejamento dos gastos.

  • Apoiar a criação, atualização e controle de elementos PEPs, bem como relatórios financeiros de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e análises de variação.

  • Realizar análises e conciliações entre diferentes sistemas e relatórios, garantindo consistência dos dados.

  • Apoiar o acompanhamento e a reconciliação de dados de scrap entre sistemas.

  • Apoiar a análise e conciliação de inventário e materiais em processo, garantindo a integridade das informações.

Informações adicionais

O QUE OFERECEMOS:

  • Wellhub para diferentes modalidades esportivas;
  • Transporte Fretado;
  • Desconto na compra de pneus;
  • Sala de aleitamento materno;
  • Programa de Apoio Conti;
  • Estacionamento no local;
  • Massoterapia no local;
  • Fisioterapia no local;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Cesta de Natal;
  • Bolsa Auxílio;
  • Kit escolar.
    • \

Pronto para dirigir com a Continental? Dê o primeiro passo e preencha o formulário online.

Qualificações

O QUE PRECISA TER

  • Cursando nível superior em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar por até 2 anos;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Power BI em Nível Intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente na fábrica de Camaçari – BA, de segunda a sexta das 07h às 14h.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER

  • Inglês em nível Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.

Descrição da empresa

A Continental desenvolve tecnologias e serviços pioneiros para a mobilidade sustentável e conectada de pessoas e seus bens. Fundada em 1871, a empresa de tecnologia oferece soluções seguras, eficientes, inteligentes e acessíveis para veículos, máquinas, tráfego e transporte. Em 2021, a Continental gerou vendas de € 33,8 bilhões e emprega atualmente mais de 190 mil pessoas em 58 países e mercados. Em 8 de outubro de 2021, celebrou-se o aniversário de 150 anos da empresa.

Com seu portfólio premium da divisão de carros, caminhões, ônibus, veículos de duas rodas e pneus especiais, o setor Tires do grupo proporciona soluções inovadoras na área da tecnologia de pneus. Os produtos e serviços inteligentes relacionados a pneus e a promoção da sustentabilidade completam o portfólio de produtos. Para os revendedores especializados e gerentes de frotas, o setor Tires oferece sistemas digitais de monitoramento e gerenciamento de pneus, além de outros serviços, com o objetivo de garantir o funcionamento das frotas e aumentar sua eficiência. Com os pneus fornecidos, a Continental faz uma contribuição significativa para a mobilidade segura, eficiente e ecológica.

description:
Amazon is looking for staffing leads (recruiters/procurement) that are motivated to lead mass recruitment programs for Amazon's logistics sites (Customer Fulfillment, Amazon Transportation Services, Amazon Logistics, or Global Specialty Fulfillment). Staffing Leads take the lead in securing personnel to achieve smooth receipt and shipment at logistics hubs. They are highly motivated and flexible to drive operational excellence for Workforce Staffing (WFS) with its major business partners.

A successful candidate must demonstrate strong consulting skills, exceptional ability to influence, organizational expertise, strong verbal and written communication skills, and a passion for building data driven programs that improve business operations. They are self‑motivated, solutions‑oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and innovative in developing best‑in‑class programs.

  • Staffing Leads input optimal information to teams that plan and execute recruitment plans (posting job advertisements, etc.).
  • Progress in securing personnel will be shared through regular meetings with those responsible for logistics base operations. If issues arise, the team will work together to resolve them.
  • Staffing Leads secure the necessary personnel through negotiations with temporary staffing agencies as well as fill Amazon direct roles.
  • Have a rigorous approach to problem solving and analytics, as well as produce, interpret, and draw conclusions from data.
  • Provide expertise, and technical/operational guidance to the stakeholders and operations leaders.
  • Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, as well as balance business needs versus constraints.
  • Establish business priorities, identifying and communicating risks and mitigation plans in collaboration with stakeholders; developing and maintaining goals, milestones and completion dates.
  • Be comfortable presenting ideas to senior level stakeholders, receptive of feedback and quick to apply changes.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Have a combination of practical and intellectual skills, as well as ability to rapidly shift and adapt to different tasks that vary between complex analyses, hands‑on projects, and project management.
  • Regular opportunities to participate and work with team members around the world in English though in person/remote meetings, reports, emails, etc.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Identify potential issues in the hiring process and ensure corrective actions/escalations are completed.
  • Deep dive operational metrics to improve performance, trouble‑shoot defects, and create remedial actions to meet goals.
  • Interact directly with Business Analysts involved in operational planning and engage in seek to understand discussions related to metric methodology and validation.
  • Perform customer/partner needs and task analysis, scope projects, and evaluate existing processes to propose solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with HR processes and systems.
  • Knowledge of HR systems.
  • Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with process improvement and stakeholder management.
  • Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards.

description:
Job description

Somos um grupo multimarcas que atua na comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, acessórios, consórcios, frota, seguros e pós-vendas realizado na nossa rede de concessionárias além do serviço de locação (mobilidade).

Buscamos umExecutivo de Vendas para promover o encantamento ao cliente que entrar no showroom da Concessionária, estando sempre atualizado sobre todos os benefícios do mix de produtos oferecidos, conhecer e aplicar técnicas eficazes de venda e negociação, identificando a necessidade de cada cliente, garantindo o fechamento do negócio e a total satisfação, com foco nos objetivos propostos para área comercial

Se você é uma pessoa ágil, que encanta o cliente e preza pela excelência em resultados, venha fazer parte do nossotime !

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente que adentrar no showroom, aplicando a metodologia do padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir os objetivos quantitativos e qualitativos, assim como as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.
  • Demonstrar, durante o atendimento ao cliente, as vantagens da marca BMW, através de comparativos com outras marcas, com o objetivo de promover o encantamento do cliente e a realização da venda.
  • Informar aos clientes as políticas comerciais do Grupo, garantindo o bom atendimento e preservação da credibilidade do Grupo.
  • Realizar financiamento, através de negociação com o cliente, com o objetivo de encontrar o melhor cálculo de financiamento para o produto, atendendo as expectativas do cliente, promovendo a satisfação do mesmo e o fechamento da negociação.
  • Realizar vendas mensais, equilibrando volume, ISC (Índice de Satisfação do Cliente), lucratividade, acessórios, F&I e serviços, buscando atingir os objetivos da empresa e individuais.
  • Atuar consultativamente junto ao cliente para conhecer e atender as necessidades, buscando ajudá-lo no processo decisório, inclusive com o uso dos conhecimentos em matemática financeira, F&I, mercado financeiro e segmento Premium.
  • Demonstrar domínio e conhecimento das características e benefícios dos produtos, conhecendo preço e condições de comercialização da loja e da concorrência, a fim de ter maior assertividade no processo e atingir as metas de vendas.
  • Acompanhar e controlar, diariamente, a sua agenda, através do sistema corporativo de gestão de relacionamento com cliente (SYONET/BIC), buscando através da prospecção atrair e gerar oportunidades de negócio, inerentes aos objetivos comerciais do Grupo.

Requirements and skills

Se você:

  • Ensino Superior Incompleto Humanas, Marketing e áreas afins;
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação, categoria B
  • Noções informática;
  • Técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Matemática Financeira;
  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Direção Defensiva

O #GrupoNewChase é o seu lugar!

Additional information

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • WellHub (Antigo Gympass) - extensivo para até 3 dependentes;
  • Telemedicina sem custo - extensivo para cônjuge, filhos e filhas;
  • Atendimento Psicológico sem custo - extensivo para cônjuge, filhos e filhas;
  • Descontos em cursos de Graduação, Pós Graduação, MBA e Inglês 100% online;
  • Universidade Corporativa;
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de empresa;
  • Programa de Atenção à Gestante.
